capex_estimate_cr_note: screener does not expose a direct capex line without an interactive schedule expansion (not available via static HTML fetch); capex approximated as Cash-from-Operating-Activity minus Free-Cash-Flow (screener's own FCF = CFO - capex convention).
shares_outstanding_note: not directly listed by screener; derivable as Equity Capital (cr) / Face Value (Rs) x 1e7, or Market Cap / Current Price for the current share count.
